text_block_list.text:
Gold City achieved a splendid result in 
the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

—It was on a day like that when Gold 
City's manager rushed into the trainer's 
office in a panic.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Me... on the cover of "Il Bianco"...?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's not just a first for 
Japan, it's a monumental achievement for 
an Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"It's an ultra-prestigious, 
long-established Italian fashion magazine! 
Gracing its cover is proof of being a 
top-tier model...!"

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: You were chosen for the cover, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ......Seriously?

Even that Gold City is at a loss for 
words. I don't quite get it, but it must 
be an incredible magazine.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Though it hasn't really sunk in at 
all. So, when does shooting start?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: ...! That's—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? Isn't that day race day!?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But the cover for "Il Bianco" is 
always shot in Italy. Without a single 
exception since its first issue...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...That's why I came to confirm how you 
really feel.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...? You want to know how I feel?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"...This decision is too heavy for you. 
That's why I even considered securing the 
contract on my own."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't make a decision before 
hearing anything from your own mouth...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Rubbed off on you from some hothead? 
That's hilarious.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Don't brush it off as a joke. So City, I 
know it's painful... but I need you to 
make a decision.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
What do you want to do? Go for the 
photoshoot? Or enter a race?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what do you think? Which one 
should I choose?
choice_data_list:
You probably know that better than anyone, 
City.

You know that best of all, don't you, 
City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pfft, right? Alright then, decided.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll do photoshoots, and I'll run in races 
too.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...!? Huh, I thought you would choose the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A little while ago, I might have answered 
immediately. Because I really love the me 
who runs.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still... the model me that you said you 
love, I don't really hate her anymore 
either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I mean, both of them are me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not giving up on modeling or 
racing. That's my answer. What do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's impossible?! Are you telling me 
to ask the staff from 'Il Bianco' to come 
all the way to Japan?!
choice_data_list: That is our job, after all.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will negotiate so that we 
can shoot in Japan. However, I won't be 
needing your assistance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to give City your full support. 
...I can't let the film crew see her 
looking defeated.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mane-G. If you can drag the staff over 
here, leave the rest to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For all the hard work we put in... No, 
I'll show you results that go even beyond 
that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I believe in you, so believe in me too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
âDid you see? The look on Manager's 
face. Never seen them that flustered 
before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Am I being too selfish?
choice_data_list:
Not at all! You can say it even more if 
you want

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Aren't you being a little too soft 
on me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well then, maybe I'll be a little 
selfish.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"We've got an interview after this, right? 
But man... I'm already itching to run!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Maybe she got some huge gig and is 
walking on air right now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Still, looks like we don't have much 
time. Now, what should we do?”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, awesome! Alright, come over to the 
track once you're done contacting them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I might look totally uncool getting all 
hyped and hyped up, but... When it comes 
to my running—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because I always want you to be watching 
me!
